description: Create builder: saved chart silently loses its Sort configuration (sort dropped from POST extra_config)
find:
pagination: config.pagination,
      sort: config.sort,
      time_grain: config.time_grain,
      ...nonEmptyMetricsField(config),
      ...(config.geographic_hierarchy && { geographic_hierarchy: config.geographic_hierarchy }),
replace:
pagination: config.pagination,
      time_grain: config.time_grain,
      ...nonEmptyMetricsField(config),
      ...(config.geographic_hierarchy && { geographic_hierarchy: config.geographic_hierarchy }),
affected_flow: Create bar/line/table chart with sort -> Save -> detail/edit page shows no sort, data unsorted

description: Create builder: changing Time Grain does not refresh the preview (time_grain missing from chartDataPayload useMemo deps)
find:
sort: config.sort,
      time_grain: config.time_grain,
      ...(builder === 'edit' && { table_columns: config.table_columns }), // BUILDER-DRIFT: edit only
replace:
sort: config.sort,
      ...(builder === 'edit' && { table_columns: config.table_columns }), // BUILDER-DRIFT: edit only
affected_flow: Bar/line on a date X axis -> pick Month/Year grain -> preview stays at previous grain until another field changes
r6_note: R6c: the preview payload is shared by both builders now (was the create page memo deps); same symptom — time grain never reaches /chart-data/

description: After creating a chart (not from dashboard) user lands on /charts list instead of the new chart's detail page
affected_flow: Create chart -> Save Chart -> expected redirect to /charts/{id}

description: isFormValid no longer requires a dimension for bar/line/pie with metrics: Save Chart enabled with X axis empty
affected_flow: Create bar chart, clear X axis -> Save button should stay disabled
r6_note: R6c: isDimensionChartConfigured feeds canSaveChart and isChartReady for both builders

description: Edit builder: filters added/changed while editing are not persisted on UPDATE EXISTING / SAVE AS NEW
find:
filters: config.filters,
      pagination: config.pagination,
      sort: config.sort,
      time_grain: config.time_grain,
      table_columns: config.table_columns,
replace:
pagination: config.pagination,
      sort: config.sort,
      time_grain: config.time_grain,
      table_columns: config.table_columns,
affected_flow: Edit chart -> add a data filter -> Save -> Update existing -> reopen: filter gone, data unfiltered

description: Edit builder chart-type switch no longer carries over Show Data Labels (keep-rule trimmed)
affected_flow: Edit chart with data labels on -> switch bar->line -> Show Data Labels resets to default

description: Switching to Pie keeps ALL metrics instead of trimming to the first one (pie ends up with 2+ metrics)
find:
metrics: prev.metrics && prev.metrics.length > 0 ? [prev.metrics[0]] : prev.metrics,
    computation_type: prev.computation_type || 'aggregated',
affected_flow: Bar with 2 metrics -> switch type to Pie -> expect a single metric row

description: Sort direction dropdown is a no-op: choosing Descending keeps the current direction
find: sort: [{ column: currentColumn, direction: value as 'asc' | 'desc' }],
affected_flow: Pick sort column -> set direction Desc -> payload/preview still asc

description: Metric limit off-by-one: pie/number/map allow a 2nd metric (+ ADD ANOTHER METRIC still visible at max)
affected_flow: Pie/number chart with one metric -> add-metric-button should be hidden

description: Auto-prefill picks the LAST text column as X axis/dimension instead of the first
affected_flow: New bar/line/pie/table chart on a dataset with 2+ text columns -> prefilled dimension is wrong column

description: Pivot 'Grand Total - Columns' toggle sends the row grand-total flag (copy-paste bug); bottom total row follows the wrong switch
affected_flow: Pivot builder -> toggle pivot-show-column-grand-total -> pivot-grand-total-row should appear (preview + saved chart)

description: Save As New ignores the name typed in the dialog; new chart is created with the original title
affected_flow: Edit chart -> Save -> SAVE AS NEW CHART -> type new name -> CREATE NEW CHART -> toast/title shows old name

description: Chart list Duplicate succeeds (toast shown) but the list is not revalidated, so 'Copy of X' never appears
affected_flow: Charts list -> row menu -> Duplicate -> new 'Copy of ...' row should be listed

description: Dragging a widget does not persist: layout reverts / is not saved after drag stop (inverted cross-tab guard)
affected_flow: Builder -> drag a chart below another -> Save -> reload: order unchanged

description: Tab rename not saved: committing the rename passes the old title
affected_flow: Builder -> click active tab title -> type new name -> Enter -> tab shows old name

description: Dashboard description is dropped from the save PUT; description edits are lost on reload
affected_flow: Builder -> edit description -> Save -> view page / reload shows old description

description: Newly added chart lands at the top of the canvas (y=0) instead of the bottom, pushing existing widgets down
affected_flow: Builder with existing widgets -> Add Chart -> new cell should be last/bottom
r6_note: R6c: bottomFullWidthItem places chart, KPI and text widgets alike

description: Deleting the active tab activates the NEXT tab instead of the previous one (off-by-one)
affected_flow: Builder with 3 tabs -> remove middle active tab -> previous tab should be selected

description: Undo skips a step: one Undo reverts two edits
find:
const previous = prev.past[prev.past.length - 1];
      const newPast = prev.past.slice(0, prev.past.length - 1);
replace:
const previous = prev.past[Math.max(0, prev.past.length - 2)];
      const newPast = prev.past.slice(0, Math.max(0, prev.past.length - 2));
affected_flow: Builder -> add text, add chart -> Undo once -> only the chart should disappear

description: View mode filter Apply: previously applied values win over new ones (merge order), so re-applying a changed filter does nothing
affected_flow: View dashboard -> set filter A -> Apply -> change to B -> Apply -> charts still filtered by A (also affects report viewer)

description: Filter panel 'Clear all' resets the widgets but charts stay filtered (parent not notified)
affected_flow: View/builder -> apply a filter -> Clear all -> charts should re-fetch unfiltered

description: 'Edit Dashboard' button navigates to the view route instead of /edit
affected_flow: Dashboard view -> Edit Dashboard -> expect /dashboards/{id}/edit builder

description: Deleting a dashboard from the list shows success toast but the row stays (list not revalidated)
affected_flow: Dashboards list -> row menu -> Delete -> confirm -> row should disappear

description: Executive summary Save sends a stale draft (summaryDraft missing from useCallback deps): typed text is lost / old or empty value PUT
affected_flow: Report viewer -> Edit summary -> type -> Save -> reload shows typed text

description: @mention dropdown doesn't open when '@' is the first character (pattern now requires preceding whitespace)
affected_flow: Open comment popover -> type '@ad' -> mention-dropdown should appear

description: Deleting a comment deletes the FIRST comment in the thread instead of the one whose menu was used (wrong id)
affected_flow: Thread with 2+ comments -> delete the latest via menu -> wrong comment becomes 'This message was deleted'

description: Create report sends period_start equal to the END date (copy-paste), so the report covers only one day
affected_flow: Create report with start+end dates -> POST /api/reports/ period_start / viewer period text

description: Share-via-email only splits recipients on commas; 'a@x.org; b@y.org' is rejected as an invalid email
affected_flow: Email PDF dialog -> enter semicolon-separated recipients -> Send should succeed

description: Reports list: clicking a new sort column starts ascending instead of descending (wrong default)
affected_flow: Reports list -> click Title header -> first click should sort desc
r6_note: R6c: useListSort is the shared list kit — charts and dashboards lists start ascending too

description: 'View Chart' from a report navigates with ?from=dashboard, so the chart page shows 'Back to Dashboard' instead of 'Back to Report'
affected_flow: Report viewer -> hover chart -> View Chart -> back button label/target should be 'Back to Report'

description: Multi-metric save regression: the chart save payload (POST /api/charts/) keeps only the first metric, so a bar/line chart with 2+ metrics is saved with a single metric (preview still shows all)
find:
function nonEmptyMetricsField(config: ChartBuilderFormData) {
  return config.metrics && config.metrics.length > 0 ? { metrics: config.metrics } : {};
replace:
function nonEmptyMetricsField(config: ChartBuilderFormData) {
  return config.metrics && config.metrics.length > 0 ? { metrics: config.metrics.slice(0, 1) } : {};
affected_flow: Create bar/line chart -> add 2 metrics -> Save -> saved chart (and POST /api/charts/ extra_config.metrics) should contain both metrics
r6_note: R6c: create and edit save share nonEmptyMetricsField

description: Chart filter value is lost: spread order reversed in the filter value onChange, so the stale filter.value ('') overwrites the newly typed value and extra_config.filters is sent with an empty value
affected_flow: Chart builder -> Add filter -> pick column/operator -> enter value -> chart-data request and save payload extra_config.filters[].value should carry the entered value; chart should be filtered

description: Resize not persisted: the undo/redo guard in handleResizeStop is inverted, so a normal user resize never commits the new layout_config (only undo/redo-time resizes would)
affected_flow: Dashboard builder -> resize a widget via handle -> Save -> reload; widget should keep new w/h (saved layout_config)

description: Image upload URL not stored: text widget upload success handler writes the previous config imageUrl instead of the response image_url, so a new upload shows no image (or the old one on replace)
affected_flow: Dashboard builder -> add text widget -> image control -> Upload image -> image should render in widget and be saved in widget config.imageUrl
